# MIT - Massachusetts Institute of Technology

> MIT is a world-leading research institution advancing scientific innovation, education, and entrepreneurship across engineering, artificial intelligence, medical technology, and numerous other fields.

MIT's web presence covers its core academic mission including undergraduate and graduate education, cutting-edge research across 30+ departments and labs, and a vibrant campus community in Cambridge. The site serves prospective students, current researchers, alumni, and visitors seeking information about the institution's programs, innovations, and engagement opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Research and Innovation
- Undergraduate Education
- Graduate Education
- Schools and Departments
- AI Research
- Medical Technology
- Entrepreneurship
- Alumni Engagement
- Campus Community
- Scientific Innovation
- Experiential Learning
- Accessibility
- Kendall Square Innovation Hub
- MIT Sloan School of Management
- School of Engineering

## Core Mission

- [MIT - Massachusetts Institute of Technology](https://web.mit.edu): MIT homepage showcasing research highlights and scientific innovation
- [About MIT](https://web.mit.edu/about): MIT institutional overview with history, leadership and campus facts
- [Research](https://web.mit.edu/research): MIT research overview with 30 departments, labs, centers and collaborations
- [Innovation](https://web.mit.edu/innovation): MIT innovation ecosystem with entrepreneurship resources and funding opportunities

## Education & Admissions

- [Education](https://web.mit.edu/education): MIT education overview covering undergraduate, graduate programs and schools
- [Admissions + Aid](https://web.mit.edu/admissions-aid): MIT admissions and financial aid for undergraduate and graduate programs

## Community & Campus Life

- [Campus Life](https://web.mit.edu/campus-life): MIT campus life covering student organizations, housing, athletics and community
- [Alumni](https://web.mit.edu/alumni): MIT alumni community with 150,000+ members and engagement resources
- [Campaign for a Better World](https://web.mit.edu/building-a-better-world): MIT Campaign for a Better World fundraising and giving initiatives

## Visitor & Support Resources

- [Visit MIT](https://web.mit.edu/visitmit): MIT campus visit information with directions, tours and welcome center
- [Contact](https://web.mit.edu/contact): MIT contact information, directory and admissions office details
- [Accessibility](https://web.mit.edu/accessibility): MIT accessibility resources and disability services for campus access

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://web.mit.edu/privacy): MIT privacy policy covering data collection and Google Analytics usage
